question.text:
The line $l_1$ has equation $y=\frac{3 x}{2} + 5$.
The line $l_2$ is perpendicular to $l_1$ and passes through $B(4,-2)$.

(a) Find an equation of $l_2$.

(b) The lines meet at $P$. Find the coordinates of $P$.
